description: Central Province - Appointed Mr. Gamini Rajaratne as the Acting Chairman of the Central Provincial Passenger Transport Services Authority with effect from 03.11.2015
reasoning: This gazette names a specific individual (Mr. Gamini Rajaratne) and his appointment to a specific post (Acting Chairman of the Central Provincial Passenger Transport Services Authority). It also names the appointing authority (Minister Ediriweera Weerawardena) and provides detailed information about his ministerial portfolios (Road Development, Transport, Power and Energy and Housing Construction). This combination of named individuals and detailed portfolio/responsibility information meets the criteria for a Hybrid Gazette (Type 3).
